alpha_geometry: Subdivide each UV-mapped triangle into 4x4 microtriangles, remove centroids with material alpha<0.5; a finer-reference check reports sensitivity. Opaque materials retain all surface.
surface_visibility: Retain sample points visible to at least one supplied input camera I1/I2/I3 by BVH ray test; nearest distance is to the entire other alpha-valid mesh.
geometry_protocol: Input-visible alpha-valid surface F1; visibility from I1/I2/I3, distance to full opposite surface; no alignment or time shift.
silhouette: Actual material alpha, alpha>=0.5. Render with common calibrated cameras and world; disable compositing and motion blur for masks.
appearance_source: Actual delivered T1.mp4 decoded at original dimensions; compare with original target RGBA PNG composited over #202630.
appearance_region: Union of reference alpha>=0.5 and candidate silhouette from the submitted 3D scene; include candidate non-background pixels from actual video. Full canvas used for any foreground outside fixed crop.
SSIM: Gaussian sigma1.5, population covariance, RGB mean; spatial map mean over foreground union.
aggregation: Exactly ten equally weighted frames. IoU equally weighted across I1/I2/I3/T1 and time. Audio covers all six seconds.
audio: Anonymous Gemini 4 Neon review of the complete 6-second submitted AV, same five 0/1/2 criteria; no waveform reference.
audio_motion_policy: Assess synchronization and dynamics against actual submitted visual motion; do not double penalize visual reconstruction errors or impose a unique bone-speed-to-sound formula.
limitations: Thresholds and linear mappings inherit earlier asset-showcase conventions, not expert calibrated professional quality cutoffs.
Ten frames may miss inter-frame faults.
Alpha microtriangle approximation sensitivity is reported.
